name: Iran nuclear programme
value: No IAEA access beyond Bushehr; HEU unverified
summary: IAEA has no access beyond Bushehr and cannot verify Iran's highly enriched uranium; E3 and US pressed Iran 19 Nov
state: The US, France, Germany and the UK told the IAEA Board on 19 Nov that Iran must restore cooperation; since February the agency has verified only at Bushehr and has lacked continuity of knowledge of Iran's highly enriched uranium for about 18 months, while Iran, Russia and China said inspections depend on an end to attacks (Israel National News). The four governments singled out Iran's declared Isfahan enrichment facility, to which the IAEA has no access. No strike on a nuclear site, NPT withdrawal or evidence of weaponisation was found to 24 Nov, so Watch holds.
for_you: There is no direct public-safety effect today. The IAEA reports regularly on Iran; its board statements and quarterly reports are the authoritative record of what inspectors can and cannot verify.
rubric_hit: Watch: inspector access curtailed (IAEA verification only at Bushehr; 60% stock unverified ~18 months)

why: A nuclear-armed Iran — or strikes to prevent one — could ignite the Gulf and send oil far higher.
drivers: Enrichment levels, IAEA access, Israeli/US military posture, snapback sanctions, talks.

rubric.alert: Strikes on nuclear sites, NPT withdrawal, or evidence of weaponisation.
rubric.watch: Enrichment at ≥ 60% or inspector access curtailed, or credible strike threats.
rubric.normal: IAEA access and active diplomacy; no escalation.
